findings.remediation: Review every subject and remove cluster-wide administrator access unless explicitly required.
Disable privileged mode unless there is a documented, tightly controlled need.

findings.message: Container demo-container explicitly runs as root.
findings.remediation: Use a dedicated non-root user and verify application compatibility.

findings.evidence: rules[0] has wildcard values in: verbs, resources, apiGroups
findings.remediation: Replace wildcard permissions with the minimum required verbs, resources, and API groups.

findings.message: RBAC rule allows all verbs on all resources.
findings.remediation: Restrict both verbs and resources to the specific operations required.

findings.message: Non-root execution is not explicitly required.
findings.remediation: Set runAsNonRoot: true and configure a compatible non-root user.

findings.message: A binding references the default service account.
findings.remediation: Consider a dedicated service account with narrowly scoped permissions.

findings.message: Container demo-container does not explicitly use a read-only root filesystem.
findings.remediation: Enable readOnlyRootFilesystem: true where the application permits it.

findings.message: Container demo-container lacks an explicit CPU or memory limit.
findings.evidence: containers[demo-container].resources.limits does not specify both cpu and memory
findings.remediation: Define appropriate CPU and memory limits based on workload testing.
